description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Critical Damage +50%] to all allies, grants [Attach Lightning], [Awoken Lightning], [Damage Cap +10000], and [Thunderous Call Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Lightning
description.text: Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Thunderous Call Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Thunderous Call after using 2 Lightning abilities

description.name: Buff Lightning 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 10%, cumulable
